# World Leader Chat newsroom v2

This release preserves all existing files and upgrades future coverage:

- News sweeps every six hours, with up to twelve diversified candidates per run.
- Coverage expands beyond politics and war to technology, AI, science, space, business, culture, entertainment, society, Congress, courts and sports.
- Same-event reporting is merged into one editorial file while every original source link is retained.
- Future approved files include a short, source-grounded article plus a 10–14-message back-and-forth conversation.
- The article must reach the same factual conclusion as the linked original reporting; wit is limited to framing and imagined reactions.
- The public front page gives 2026 three columns and moves 2020–2025 into expandable year archives.
- Public language is simplified to one clear disclosure, and repository/deployment language is removed from the live presentation.
